senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (चयते)
To go to or towards, to go, to move.

m. (-यः)
1 An assemblage, a multitude.
2 A heap, a collection.
3 A mound of earth, raised to form the foundation of a building.
4 A rampart or mound of earth raised from the ditch of a fort.
5 The gate of a fort.
6 Any edifice.
7 A seat, a stool.
8 A cover, a covering.
E.
चि to collect, aff. अच्

(ऋ) चायृ r. 1st cl. (चायति-ते)
1 To worship, to revere.
2 To discern, to perceive.

n. (-नं)
Collecting, gathering.
E.
चि to collect, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be collected or gathered.
E.
चि to collect, अनीयर् aff.
